name: Fact Measurement + Program v1

scope.LOCO: all five classes; normal vs logical only
scope.VID-AD: all ten scenarios and five capture conditions; full50 and type subgroups
scope.AutoVI: engine_wiring fastening and blue_hoop only; all three missing-part categories cancelled by user

training.architecture: ImageNet WRN50_2 through layer3 with global context, classwise centers/boxes/semantic masks/paired axial endpoints
training.initialization: ImageNet only; no prior domain checkpoint
training.schedule: cosine; freeze encoder first2 epochs; freeze BN statistics
training.loss: focal center +3 weighted semantic BCE/Dice +3 box L1 +3 permutation-invariant axial L1
training.supervision: normal train component facts only; existing normal annotations/weak labels; no anomaly class loss
training.augmentation: same-parent move/add/remove60% with overlap rejection; horizontal/vertical flips; brightness/gamma/blur; all factual targets updated
training.checkpoint_selection: normal DEV originals plus deterministic same-parent edits; macro .8 pointF1+.2 weak-mask Dice; assess epoch1 and every4; first maximum wins
training.readout: same finite heat threshold grid and segmentation threshold/area grid for every category; selected with factual DEV metric

facts.interface: class, center, box, paired axial endpoints, semantic masks; deterministic geometry/color/containment/binding facts
facts.category_specific: object label vocabulary and factual predicate definitions, not optimization hyperparameters
facts.OCR: fresh deterministic Qwen2.5-VL-3B transcription of printed rope label; same fixed prompt; normal and test phases separated; no Qwen anomaly reasoning/training
facts.liquid_attribute_classifier: fixed C=1 logistic classifier on measured normal TRAIN liquid-color descriptors and annotated fruit variant; no test fitting

rules.implementation: features.py raw predicates + program.py shared executor
rules.interval_fit: normal TRAIN q1/q99, scale=max(range,10% median magnitude,.01), padding=max(.25 scale, maximum normalDEV outside-distance)
rules.unknown: record unavailable fact names; one unavailable residual=1; no claim this establishes epistemic sufficiency
rules.fusion: per-rule empirical upper-tail references on normal TRAIN per deployment task, continuous extrapolation beyond maximum, max+0.01sum; same for all datasets
rules.rule_changes: visual measurement does not consume rule values; this rerun does not itself establish intervention generalization

calibration.role: LOCO official normal validation; original frozen VID/Auto normal calibration partitions
calibration.threshold: per deployment task normal score q95(method=higher); strict greater-than

split: preserve audited original-parent roles, cross-condition frame groups and Auto pixel-duplicate exclusions; no new resplit after seeing scores
freeze: training sources/code/hyperparameters hash before training; checkpoints/readouts/rules/normal calibration hash before final fresh test inference; OCR weights/prompt independently frozen before OCR phases
limitations: Retrospective development rerun: public test sets were inspected in earlier rounds.
Normal component supervision differs from normal-only baselines; frontend/annotation budgets must be disclosed.
No trained active acquisition policy, general LLM reasoner or proved evidence sufficiency.
No established video/physical-instance-independent split for VID.
One seed; no post-result variant selection.

baseline_plan.SALAD: continue VID10 + AutoVI engine only; cancel all three missing-part categories across methods
baseline_plan.PUAD: continue VID10 + AutoVI engine only; missing-part categories cancelled
baseline_plan.LogiCo: completed14/14; retain results and adaptation-quality caveat
baseline_plan.LogicAD: retain user-approved local FE-fast adaptation; not original full method
baseline_plan.ComAD: retain completed adaptation; frontend differences disclosed
baseline_plan.comparison: frozenFMP-v1 all native outputs, no mixing previous ours checkpoints/scores with new main row

scope_change: User explicitly cancelled only missing-part experiments; retains engine_wiring. Model/training/scoring hyperparameters unchanged before full training.
